# Studio HDRI

`studio_small_08` from Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com/a/studio_small_08), licence CC0 (public domain).

- `studio_small_08_1k.hdr`: High quality
- `studio_small_08_2k.hdr`: Ultra quality
